description: Synthetic history for the EX-* example portfolios: what a registry feed cannot carry. Loaded by seedExamples; every name, number and date is invented.

criteria.evidence: Example: GPC3 binding assay, Z' 0.64 over 8 plates
Example: K1 TR-FRET assay, Z' 0.71 over 12 plates
Example: P2 FRET cleavage assay, Z' 0.58 over 6 plates
Example: KD 2.1 nM by SPR, best of 4 clones
Example: KD 6.5 nM by SPR on 2 clones
Example: clinical supply plan v1.0 signed off

decisions.rationale: Kick-off: ion channel C4 enters target validation
No-go: the C4 screen closed without a tractable series; target dropped
Kick-off: GPCR G3 enters target validation
Kick-off: kinase K1 enters target validation
Go: binding assay validated; start hit finding
Go: K1 assay validated; run the primary screen
Go: spiropiperidine series GPC-A validated with sub-micromolar compounds
Go: aminopyrimidine series KIN-A validated; best IC50 20 nM. Indazoles kept as backup
Kick-off: protease P2 enters target validation
Kick-off: T-cell engager, after the first panning round
Go: binders below 10 nM from phage display; optimize the best two clones
Hold: deprioritized at the portfolio review; restart when the RTK-2 biology reads out
Go: tox lot released and IND quality module filed; start process characterization
Hold: process validation postponed until the drug substance site change is done

observations.subject: series
observations.title: Para-fluoro costs hERG margin
observations.finding: EXC-3002 has hERG IC50 4.5 uM against 30 uM for EXC-3001; potency barely moves. Avoid the para-fluoro benzyl.

observations.subject: program
observations.title: Two clones aggregate above 50 mg/mL
observations.finding: Clones 3 and 7 form aggregates at high concentration; clone 1 does not. Developability should lead with clone 1.
